kalā: [Kala+a+ā] (thī) CL=7 [Kalīyate ekādinā saṅkhyāyateti kalā. Dhāna, ṭī.53.] (1) Small part. (2) 16th part of a month. (3) Art (or) craft (or) handicraft. (4) The special period. (5) Increase wealth. (6) Mathematics.
kalāpa: [Kala+pā+a] (pu) CL=7 [Kalaṃ avayavaṃpāti rakkhatīti kalāpo. Dhāna, ṭī. 631.(kalā+āpa+ṇa. Thoma)] Cell. Group of elementary particles. Bundle. A pile. A sheaf. (This Kalāpasadda explains according to a state of affairs if bind paddy stalks that is called a sheaf. If bind bamboo that is called a bundle of bamboo. If binds hair that is called a switch (of hair) (or) hair-knot). Kalāpa(pu) [ka+lasa+ṇa. Komayūrolasati yena kalāpo. Ṇo, Sassapo. Dhāna, ṭī. 635.] A bundle of a peacock tail. Kalāpa(pu) [kalāpa+ṇa. Sarasamūhānaṃ ṭhānattā kalāpo. Dhāna, ṭī. 389.] A quiver.
kalāpabaddha: [Kalāpa+baddha] (ti) CL=7 It was combined as a bundle or a pile (or) a group of elementary particles that are combined.
kalāpadvayasahābhāva: [Kalāpa+dvaya+saha+abhāva] (pu) CL=7 Two elementary particles that are not together.
kalāpagga: [Kalāpa+agga] (ti) CL=7 (1) A tip of a bundle of peacock tails. (2) Harvest donation (or) Celebrates Donation ceremony after harvested (paddy).
kalāpaggāha: [Kalāpa+gāha] (pu) CL=7 is taken as a group (such as a group of elementary particles. (or) is taken by a combination as a bundle or a pile.
kalāpakaraṇa: [Kalāpa+karaṇa] (na) CL=7 Doing a sheaf. Making a knot. Doing a bundle.
kalāpantara: [Kalāpa+antara] (na) CL=7 A kind of elementary particle. See - Kalāpantaragata.
kalāpantarabhūta: [Kalāpantara+bhūta] (pu,na) CL=7 Mahābhuta that is inclusive of a kind element.
kalāpantaragata: [Kalāpantara+gata] (ti) CL=7 It is in a group of elementary particles.
kalāpantararūpa: [Kalāpantara+rūpa] (na) CL=7 A physical form that arises inside of an element.
kalāpasammasana: [Kalāpa+sammasana] (na) CL=7 [Atītādivasena anekabhedabhinne dhamme kalāpato saṅkhipitvā sammasanaṃ kalāpasammasanaṃ. Visuddhi, ṭī, 2. 386.] Comprehension by groups. See original.
kalāpasammasanañāṇa: [Kalāpasammasana+ñāṇa] (na) CL=7 The wisdom that comprehends by groups. The wisdom that comprehends 11 forms by groups.
kalāpasannaddha: [Kalāpa+sannaddha] (ti) CL=7 One who carries a quiver (of arrows) slung over the shoulder.
kalāpasantānamūla: [Kalāpa+santāna+mūla] (na) CL=7 The continuity of a group of elementary particles that is an origin (or) root.
kalāpavikāra: [Kalāpa+vikāra] (pu) CL=7 The transformation of a group of elementary particles.
kalāpavipassanā: [Kalāpa+vipassanā] (thī) CL=7 Insights a group of elementary particles.
kalāpiya: [Kalāpa+iya] (pu) CL=7 A bundle (or) sheaf. See - Kalāpiyasata.
kalāpā: [Kala+pā+a+ā] (thī) CL=7 A belt (or) girdle (ornament of a waist). (A girdle that has a rope or string that is called Kāñcī. A girdle that has 8 strings or ropes that is called Mekhalā. A girdle that has 16 strings or ropes that is called Rasanā. A girdle that has 25 strings or ropes that is called Kalāpā (group).
kalāpānupālaka: [Kalāpa+anupālaka] (ti) CL=7 Guarding a group of elementary particles.
kalāpī: [Kalāpa+ī.(kalāpina-saṃ)] (pu) CL=7 (1) Peacock. (Ti) (2) One who has a quiver.
kalāya: [Ka+lā+ya] (pu) CL=7 [Kaṃ vātaṃ lātīti kaḷāyo, ḷattaṃ, kalāyampi. Dhāna, ṭī. 451.(kala+aya+ṇa-saṃ)] The name of a kind of bean. (A lablab bean Dolichos Lablab Var Lignosus, Cowpea Vigna Catjang, A chickpea, Green peas, Pigeon pea Cajanus Cajan. Mung bean Phaseolus Radiatus that is natural growth at the base of a mountain. Cowpea Vigna Catjang).
kalāyamatti:
[Kalāya+matta]  CL=9 'Just as the final "a" in "kesākesi" is changed to "i", the final "a" of the word "matta" is changed to "i". [Reference: Rū. Nhā. 207]'
'Meaning: Having the size of a black gram seed.'
kalība: [Kala+iva] (na) CL=7 [Dhāna, ṭī. Sya.] Neuter gender. One who is a neuter gender. (who is not a girl and is not a boy).
kalīra: [Kala+īra] (pu) CL=7 The sprout (or) soft part above the stem of a palm tree.
kalīyati: [Kala+ya+te] (kri) CL=7 (A) Should compare. See - Kalī. (B) Cause one to lose.
kama: [Kamu+ṇa] (pu) CL=7 [Anupubbyapumekamo. Dhāna. Dhāna, ṭī. 429. Nīti, dhā. 219.] (1) Consequence (or) continuity. (This means the process of an event, the rejection sequence, rules of conduct or practice, The sequence of realms, and the sequence of preaching).
kamabheda: [Kama+bheda] (pu) CL=7 The special succession. The special arrangement.
kamala: [Kama+ala] (na) CL=7 [Kāmīyatīti kamalaṃ, paṅkajaṃ. Moga, 7. 182. Ka+ala+a. Kaṃ jalaṃ alayati bhūsayatīti kamalaṃ. Dhāna, ṭī. 685.] (A) Lotus. (B) A forest where lotuses dense grow.
kamaladalasadisanayana: [Kamaladala+sadisa+nayana] (ti) CL=7 One whose eyes are like lotus leaves. See - Padmapattak.
kamaladalavattivaṭṭaṅguli: [Kamaladala+vatti+vaṭṭa+aṅguli] (ti) CL=7 One whose finger is like a roll of a lotus leaf.
kamalakomala: [Kamala+komala] (ti) CL=7 As soft as a lotus.
kamalakuvalayapuṇḍarīkasaṇḍamaṇḍita: [Kamala+kuvalaya+puṇḍarika+saṇḍa+maṇḍita] (ti) CL=7 Adorned with a variety of lotus such as Padumma lotus, white lotus, red lotus, and blue lotus. See also - Kamala...salila.
kamalakuvalayasamalaṅkata: [Kamalakuvalaya+samalaṅkata] (ti) CL=7 (A blessed garden) that is decorated with a variety of lotus such as Padumma lotus, white lotus, red lotus, and blue lotus. See also - Kamala...salila.
kamalakuvalayasañchanna: [Kamalakuvalaya+sañchanna] (ti) CL=7 Covered with a variety of lotus such as Padumma lotus, white lotus, red lotus, and blue lotus. See also - Kamala...salila.
kamalakuvalayujjala: [Kamalakuvalaya+ujjala] (ti) CL=7 Bright with a variety of lotus such as Padumma lotus, white lotus, red lotus, and blue lotus. See also - Kamala...salila.
kamalakuvalayujjalavimalasādhurasasalila: [Kamalakuvalayujjala+vimala+sādhurasa+salila] (ti) CL=7 Water that is pure and bright with a variety of lotus such as Padumma lotus, white lotus, red lotus, and blue lotus.
kamalamakula: [Kamala+makula] (pu,na) CL=7 A lotus bud. See - Pañjalīkata.
kamalamakulākāra: [Kamala+makuḷa+ākāra] (pu) CL=7 Like a shape of a lotus bud.
kamalamakuḷākāra: [Kamala+makuḷa+ākāra] (pu) CL=7 Like a shape of a lotus bud.
kamalapattakkha: [Kamala+patta+akkhi] (ti) CL=7 One whose eyes are like lotus leaves.
kamalapādukā: [Kamala+pādukā] (thī) CL=7 Slipper made of grass (or of lotus leaf).
kamalasaṇḍa: [Kamala+saṇḍa] (pu) CL=7 All of the group of lotuses. A forest where lotuses dense grow.
kamalatiṇa: [Kamala+tiṇa] (na) CL=7 Grass that is named lotus. Lotus grass. See - Kamalapādukā.
kamalavana: [Kamala+vana] (na) CL=7 A forest where lotuses dense grow. See - Kamala-(B).
kamalavanavikasanakara: [Kamalavana+vikasana+kara] (ti) CL=7 (The sun) that is doing to blossom lotus.
kamalaṅghanarahita: [Kama+laṅghana+rahita] (ti) CL=7 Free from jumping all the sequence.
kamalodarasappabha: [Kamala+udara+sappabha] (ti) CL=7 One whose color (skin color) is like lotus color.
kamalā: [Kamala+a+ā] (thī) CL=7 A flower whose shape is like a beautiful girl. A (mythology) flower of the Suyaung plant. See - Kamalasadisitthī.
kamalānanalocana: [Kamala+ānana+locana] (ti) CL=7 One whose face and eyes are like a lotus.
kamalāsadisitthī: [Kamalā+sadisā+itthī] (thī) CL=7 A woman who is like a flower that flower"s shape is like a beautiful girl.
kamamāna: [Kamu+māna] (ti) CL=7 (A) Going along. repeatedly travels. (B) Traveled (or) Went. (C) Believes in. (D) Entered.
kamana: [Kamu+yu] (na) CL=7 (1) (A) Walking. (B) Entering. See - Kanta. (Ti) (2) Desires. See - Kamanaṭṭha.
kamanasatti: [Kamana+satti] (thī) CL=7 The power of walking (or) moving, See - Kamamāna.
kamanasattisabbhāva: [Kamanasatti+sabbhāva] (pu) CL=7 The existence of the power of moving. See - Kamana-(A).
kamanaṭṭha: [Kamana+attha] (pu) CL=7 The meaning of a state of wanting.
kamanta: [Kamu+anta] (ti) CL=7 One who is going (or) walking.
kamantaka: [Kamanta+ka] (na) CL=7 A top of a head (or) top (or) peak (or) a head.
kamantu: [Kamu+a+antu] (kri) CL=7 May they take place. See - Kamati.
kamanīyarūpa: [Kamanīya+rūpa] (ti) CL=7 One whose appearance is adorable. See - Abhikkantavaṇṇa.
kamanīyaṭṭha: [Kamanīya+attha]  CL=10 The meaning that is desirable (or) meaning of desirable. see kammaṭṭha
kamasabbaññū: [Kama+sabbaññū] (ti) CL=7 One who understands everything ( an epithet of the Buddha). See - Sabbaññū.
kamati: [Kamu+a+ti] (kri) CL=7 (A) He goes. He flies. (B) He closes to. (C) He enters. (He destroys). (D) He overcomes. (E) He happens. He believes. (F) He takes place. (G) He steps on. (H) He insights.
kamavattinī: [Kama+vatta+inī]  CL=9 A word that happens in order.
kamavutti: [Kama+vutti] (thī) CL=7 Way of being in succession.
kamaṇḍalu: [Kamaṇḍa+lā+u] (pu,na) CL=7 [Kassa jalassa maṇḍo pasannabhāvo kamaṇḍo, taṃ lātīti kamaṇḍalu, u. Dhāna, ṭī. 443.] (A) A water pitcher (or) jar. (B) A water pot.
kamaṇḍaludaka: [Kamaṇḍalu+udaka] (na) CL=7 The water in the jar.
kamaṇḍaludhara: [Kamaṇḍalu+dhara+a] (ti) CL=7 One who is carrying a water pitcher.
kamaṇḍaludhārī: [Kamaṇḍalu+dhara+ṇī] (ti) CL=7 One who carries a water pitcher. See - Kamaṇḍaluka.
kamaṇḍaluka: [Kamaṇḍalu+ka] (ti) CL=7 One who carries a water pitcher.
kamaṇḍalūdaka: [Kamaṇḍalu+udaka] (na) CL=7 The water in the jar (or) water pitcher.
kambaka: [Tamu+ṇvu] (pu) CL=7 [Tamu kaṅkhāyaṃ, ṇvu, bandho ca. Dhāna, ṭī. 598.] (1) Species of amaranth used as a vegetable Amaranthus Blitum. (2) A sweet Flag Acorus Calamus.
kambala: [Kamu+ala] (pu,na) CL=7 [Kamanīyattā kambalo. Dhāna, ṭī. 291.] Wool thread. See also - Kambalapādukā. (2) Woolen clothing. Clothing that is made of woolen such as a robe. (3) Ivory color. A pale color. See -  Kambalamaddana. Kambala  (Pu). Kambala Dragon.
kambalacora: [Kambala+cora] (pu) CL=7 A thief who steals woolen rug.
kambalacīvarasaññā: [Kambala+cīvara+saññā] (thī) CL=7 The recognized sign that is a woolen robe.
kambaladāyakatissa: [Kambala+dāyaka+tissa] (pu) CL=7 A novice is named Tissa who offers woolen rugs.
kambaladāyakatissatthera: [Kambaladāyakatissa+thera] (pu) CL=7 A Thera is named Tissa who offers woolen rugs.
kambalageṇḍuka: [Kambala+geṇḍuka] (pu) CL=7 Playing with a woolen ball.
kambalakūṭāgāra: [Kambala+kūṭāgāra] (na) CL=7 A building with a peaked roof that is covered with a woolen rug. A coffin that has a finial that is covered with a woolen rug.
kambalamaddana: [Kambala+maddana] (na) CL=7 It dyes to get ivory color (pale color).
kambalapariyonaddha: [Kambala+pariyonaddha] (ti) CL=7 Wrapping with woolen rug in all directions.
kambalaratana: [Kambala+ratana]  CL=9 The gem called a woollen stuff- blanket or garment.
kambalasuttakoṭi: [Kambalasutta+koṭi] (thī) CL=7 The tip of woolen thread.
kambalatthika: [Kambala+atthika] (ti) CL=7 One who desires to get a woolen rug.
kambalavaṇṇa: [Kambala+vaṇṇa] (ti) CL=7 The appearance of the woolen rug.
kambalayāna: [Kambala+yāna] (na) CL=7 A vehicle made of woolen.
kamboja:
[Kambukaja+oja]  CL=10 1. One who has strength derived from the jaw/teeth.
2. Kamboja (masculine gender) [kambu + oja + a]
3. Country Kamboja: Kambunāsambukena ojanti tassaṃ vohārakaraṇatoti kambojā. Dhāna, ṭī. 185.]
'They speak with a conch shell in that region, therefore [the people are called] Kamboja.'
kambojaka: [Kamboja+ka] (ti) CL=7 One who is being in Kamboja Country.
kambojaraṭṭhasambhava: [Kambojaraṭṭha+sambhava] (ti) CL=7 One who is being in Kamboja Country. See - Kambojaka.
kambojaraṭṭhavāsī: [Kambojaraṭṭha+vasa+ṇī] (ti) CL=7 One who used to live in Kambojaka Country.
kambojigumba: [Kamboji+gumba] (pu) CL=7 The forest where Nagro or wild coffee Cassia tora trees dense grow. See - Eḷagalāgumba.
kambu: [Kamba+u] (pu,na) CL=7 [Dhāna, ṭī. 263.] Gold. See - Kambukāyūradhara. Kambu(pu,na) [ka+vā+u. Kaṃ vāti gacchatīti kambu, u, dvepyanitthiyaṃ. Dhāna, ṭī. 676.] (1) Conch shell. (2) Mussel. See - Kamboja. (3) Bracelet. See also - Kambukāyūradhara-(8).
kambugīvā: [Kambu+gīvā] (thī) CL=7 [Kambu vuccati suvaṇṇaṃ, kambumayena āliṅgena sannibhāgīvā. Dhāna, ṭī. 263.] (1) A neck likes a small gold drum with tapering ends. A neck that has three wrinkles. A gold neck. (Ti) (2) One whose neck is like a small gold drum with tapering ends.
kambukeyūradhara: [Kambu+keyūra+dhara] (ti) CL=7 One who is wearing a gold bracelet.
kambukāyūradhara: [Kambu+kāyūra+dhara] (ti) CL=7 (A) One who is wearing bracelets. (B) One who is wearing a bracelet worn on the upper arm. (C) One who is wearing a bracelet that is made of a conch shell.
kambuparihāraka: [Kambu+parihāraka] (na) CL=7 Gold bracelets. The ornament of the arm (such as a bracelet) that is made of gold.
kambusahattha: [Kambusa+hattha] (ti) CL=7 One who decorates an arm with golden ornaments (such as a bracelet).
kambutalābhāsa: [Kambu+tala+ābhāsa] (ti) CL=7 Likes a flat surface of a golden small drum with tapering ends.
kambuvimaṭṭhadhāra: [Kambuvimaṭṭha+dhara+ṇa] (ti) CL=7 [In Thī -dhārinī.] One who is wearing fine golden ornaments.
kameyyaṃ: [Kamu+a+eyyaṃ]  CL=9 Would go back. See kamati.
kamitapubba: [Kamita+pubba]  CL=9 One who went in the past, one who has gone before. See - Kamamāna.
kamma: [Kara+ramma] (na) CL=7 [Karīyatīti kammaṃ. Rū. 589.] Kamma (or) deed ( merit Kamma, demerit Kamma, Vinaya Kamma). (2) Parikamma (meditation of Samatha and Vipassanā). (3) Striving. Diligence. (4) The matter. (5) Kammavācā (Vinaya) proclamation of the legal proposition; official legal statement). See - Kammasaṃyoga. (7) Deeds. See - Kammappavacanīya. (Ti) (8) One who the legal procedure is done for. See - Kammakata-(1). See original—Kamma (na) [kamu+ramma] The benefit that should want.
kammabaddha: [Kamma+baddha] (pu) CL=7 Kamma that is a cause of binding. Binds (or) attaches by deeds. (This means reaching a state of Kammapatha (cause of action)).
kammabaddhavinicchaya: [Kammabaddha+vinicchaya] (pu) CL=7 Discrimination that is related to the deed.
kammabahula: [Kamma+bahula] (ti) CL=7 Busy (or) Has a lot of state of affairs (or) matter.
kammabalavavatthita: [Kammabala+vavatthita] (ti) CL=7 Analyzed by the power of Kamma.
kammabandha: [Kamma+baddha] (pu) CL=7 Kamma that is a cause of formation. It is formed by Kamma. (This means reaching a state of Kammapatha (cause of action)).
kammabandhagaṇanā: [Kammabandha+gaṇanā] (thī) CL=7 Counting the relation of Kamma.
kammabandhavimokkha: [Kammabandha+vimokkha] (pu) CL=7 Liberated from the attachment of relation of Kamma.
kammabandhu: [Kamma+bandhu] (ti) CL=7 One who is related to the actions. See - Kammadāyāda.
kammabandhābhāva: [Kammabandha+abhāva] (pu) CL=7 An absence of relation of Kamma (actions).
kammabhava: [Kamma+bhava] (pu) CL=7 Kamma that causes the result that is existence. Kammically accumulative existence. (Related to the will of merit and demerit such as Abhijjha that are Kammabhava (Kammically accumulative existence).
kammabhavahetuka: [Kammabhava+hetu+ka] (ti) CL=7 Has a cause that is Kammabhava (Kammically accumulative existence).
kammabhavakāraṇa: [Kammabhava+kāraṇa] (na) CL=7 A cause of Kammabhava (Kammically accumulative existence).
kammabhavapaccaya: [Kammabhava+paccaya] (pu) CL=7 (1) The cause that is Kammabhava (Kammically accumulative existence). (Ti) (2) Has a cause that is Kammabhava (Kammically accumulative existence).
kammabhaṅga: [Kamma+bhaṅga] (pu) CL=7 Dissolution for action or deed.
kammabhūmi: [Kamma+bhūmi] (thī) CL=7 (A) A place of making an effort. A realm that is suitable to strive. (B) A place of doing a matter. A working place.
kammabyatihāra: [Kamma+byatihāra]  CL=10 Reciprocal action. (In 'aññamañassa bhojaka,' the first person initially feeds the second person, and the second person then feeds the first person in return. This reciprocal act of feeding is called 'kamma-byatihāra.' In Moggallāna"s grammar 1.56, the term 'vītihāra' is used, and in Pañcikā, it is explained as 'aññamañña-kiriyā-karaṇaṃ vītihāro.')
kammaccheda: [Kamma+cheda] (pu) CL=7 Cutting the volitional action. Absence for doing the matter.
kammacetanā: [Kamma+cetanā] (thī) CL=7 Having intention that is a deed.
kammacitta: [Kamma+citta] (na) CL=7 (1) Consciousness of action. (2) Mystery of deeds. See also - Kammaviññāṇa.
kammacittīkata: [Kamma+cittīkata] (ti) CL=7 Kamma is a mysterious deed.
kammadheyya: [Kamma+dheyya] (na) CL=7 (A) Work activity. (B) The matter of what should be done.
kammadhorayha: [Kamma+dhorayha] (ti) CL=7 One who is able to do the burden. (An executive).
kammadhura: [Kamma+dhura] (pu,na) CL=7 Carrying out the case Dhura: See also - Dhura.
kammadhāraya: [Kamma+dhāraya]  CL=10 Kammadharaya compound, a compound that carries meaning like karma. (Just as karma carries both action and result, compounds like "mahapurisa" carry two names such as "mahanta" and "purisa". Because it carries these two names, it is called a kammadharaya compound.)
kammadhārayasamāsa: [Kammadhāraya+samāsa] (pu) CL=7 Kammadhāraya Samāsa. (Associate with oppositional compound).
kammadhārayasamāsattadīpana: [Kammadhārayasamāsatta+dīpana] (na) CL=7 The explanation for the state of Kammadhāraya Samāsa. (Associate with oppositional compound).
kammadosa: [Kamma+dosa] (pu) CL=7 (1) The flaw of Kamma (deeds). The flaw of a matter. (2) Kamma (activity) that has a flaw.
kammadukkaṭa: [Kamma+dukkaṭa] (na) CL=7 An inferior matter (or) case (or) action.
kammadussaka: [Kamma+dusa+ṇvu] (ti) CL=7 One who dislikes wholesome deeds.
kammadvāra: [Kamma+dvāra] (na) CL=7 (1) A cause that is Kamma (deed). (2) A cause of arising Kamma. A place of arising Kamma. (There are three Kammadvāra (the door of action) they are Kāyakammadvāra (body), vacīkammadvāra (speech), and manokammadvāra (mind)).
kammadvārabheda: [Kammadvāra+bheda] (pu) CL=7 Variety of Kaṃma, dvāra (the door of action).
kammadvāravavatthāna: [Kammadvāra+vavatthāna] (na) CL=7 Analyzed Kaṃma, dvāra (the door of action).
kammadvārābhedana: [Kammadvāra+abhedana] (na) CL=7 Without breaking of Kaṃma, dvāra (the door of action).
kammadāya: [Kamma+dāya] (ti) CL=7  The consequence of Kamma. One who bears the consequences of actions.
kammadāyajja: [Kamma+dāyajja] (na) CL=7 (1) The inherits that is Kamma (deeds). The inherits action. (Ti) (2) One who has inherited action. See - Kammadāyāda.
kammagabbha: [Kamma+gabbha] (ti) CL=7 Inside the room of Kamma. Sinks in the Kamma chamber.
kammagaru: [Kamma+garu] (ti) CL=7 One who respects his work.
kammagaruka: [Kamma+garu+ka] (ti) CL=7 One who is giving importance to Kamma.
kammagati: [Kamma+gati] (ti) CL=7 Future destination of Kamma. The consequence of Kamma (deeds).
kammaggahaṇa: [Kamma+gahaṇa] (na) CL=7 (1) Undertaking of activity. See - Kammasamādāna. (2) Kammasaddā.
kammaghaṭita: [Kamma+ghaṭita] (ti) CL=7 Connected to Kamma (activity). See - Kammayantavighāṭana.
kammaguṇa: [Kamma+guṇa] (pu) CL=7 The consequence of activity (or) The result of deeds.
kammahetukathā: [Kammahetu+kathā] (thī) CL=7 Words (sound) that explain the cause of Kamma. (Words (sound) that are asking and answering words in section 11 Aṭṭhamavaga Abhidhammāpiṭakata kathāvatthu pāḷi and that words (sound) or sentence which is called Kammahetukathā).
kammahāni: [Kamma+hāni] (thī) CL=7 Making to decrease action (or) deed. See - Kammabhaṅga.
kammahīna: [Kamma+hīna] (ti) CL=7 One who lost work. The jobless.
kammaja: [Kamma+jana+kvi] (ti) CL=7 [Kamma+ja. Ja-saddo jātattho. Maṇimañjū, 2. 194.] Arisen due to Kamma.
kammajaarūpakkhandha: [Kammaja+arūpakkhandha] (pu) CL=7 The aggregates consciousness (or) the consciousness body due to Kamma.
kammajaiddhi: [Kammaja+iddhi] (thī) CL=7 Psychic power due to Kamma.
kammajakalāpa: [Kammaja+kalāpa] (pu) CL=7 An aggregate of being due to Kamma.
kammajakāya: [Kammaja+kāya] (pu) CL=7 The aggregates embodying of being due to Kamma.
kammajamahābhūtasambhava: [Kammaja+mahābhūta+sambhava] (ti) CL=7 Arisen together with great elements due to Kamma.
kammajaojā: [Kammaja+ojā] (thī) CL=7 Nutritive essence that is produced by Kamma (deeds).
kammajapasāda: [Kammaja+pasāda] (pu) CL=7 Pasādarūpa (sense faculty) that is generated by Kamma(deeds).
kammajapavatta: [Kamma+pavatta] (pu) CL=7 Produced by action (circle of existence).
kammajapaveṇī: [Kammaja+paveṇī] (thī) CL=7 Produced by action that is arisen in succession (lineage).
kammajaroga: [Kammaja+roga] (pu) CL=7 Disease due to Kamma. See - Kammavipāka.
kammajarūpa: [Kammaja+rūpa] (na) CL=7 A form (or) physical body that is arisen by Kamma (action). (9 factors of Ekanakammajarūpaby Hadayavatthu (physical location of the mind) such as Cakkhu (eye), sota(ear), ghāna(nose), jivhā(tongue), kāya(body), itthibhāva (state of being a woman), pumbhāva(male), jīvita(life), and . 8 factors of Avinibbhogarūpa (indistinct shape or sight). 9 factors of Anekanakammajarūpa. All of 18 factors of Kammajarūpa).
kammajarūpapariyāpanna: [Kammajarūpa+pariyāpanna] (ti) CL=7 It is inclusive of Kammajarūpa (a form (or) physical body that is arisen by Kamma (action)).
kammajarūpapaveṇī: [Kammajarūpa+paveṇī] (thī) CL=7 The lineage (succession) of Kammajarūpa (a form (or) physical body that is arisen by Kamma (action)).
kammajarūpappavatti: [Kammajarūpa+pavatti] (thī) CL=7 Arisen Kammajarūpa (a form (or) physical body that is arisen by Kamma (action)) in succession.
kammajarūpasantati: [Kammajarūpa+santati] (thī) CL=7 The sequence of arisen Kammajarūpa (a form (or) physical body that is arisen by Kamma (action)).
kammajasantāna: [Kammaja+santāna] (pu) CL=7 The sequence of arisen Kammajarūpa (a form (or) physical body that is arisen by Kamma (action)).
kammajateja: [Kammaja+teja] (pu) CL=7 (A) Heat due to Kamma. See - Usmā. (B) Digestive faculty due to Kamma. Pācakateja.
kammajatejapaccaya: [Kammajateja+paccaya] (pu) CL=7 A cause that is digestive faculty due to Kamma.
kammajatejodhātu: [Kammajateja+dhātu] (thī) CL=7 (A) Fiery state that arose due to Kamma. See - Usmā. (B) Digestive faculty due to Kamma. Pācakatejodhāta. See - Gahaṇī.
kammajatejodhātūpanibandha: [Kammajatejodhātu+upanibandha] (ti) CL=7 Related to the fiery state that arose due to Kamma. See - Usmūpanibandha.
kammajatejusmā: [Kammajateja+usmā] (thī) CL=7 Heat due to Kamma. Kammajateje.
kammajatihetukapaṭisandhipaññā: [Kammaja+tihetukapaṭisandhi+paññā] (thī) CL=7 The wisdom of having three causes of rebirth-linking that arose due to Kamma. (Wisdom that arises starting from rebirth-linking state).
kammajavāta: [Kammaja+vāta] (pu) CL=7 The wind that produced by an action. Kammaja air.
kammajusmā: [Kammaja+usmā] (thī) CL=7 Heat (body temperature) arises due to Kamma.
kammajāhāra: [Kammaja+āhāra] (pu) CL=7 Nutrition is arisen due to Kamma.
kammajānanakāla: [Kamma+jānana+kāla] (pu) CL=7 A period of understanding Kamma.
kammajāta: [Kamma+jāta] (na) CL=7 Kamma. Job. The job that is reformed by Kamma (activity).
kammakammaphalalakkhaṇa: [Kamma+kammaphala+lakkhaṇa] (ti) CL=7 The auspicious sign that is Kamma and the fruit of Kamma.
kammakammaphalasaddhā: [Kammakammaphala+saddhā] (thī) CL=7 Belief in Kamma and the fruit of Kamma.
kammakammaphalavibhāga: [Kamma+kammaphala+vibhāga] (pu) CL=7 Analyzed Kamma and the fruit of Kamma.
kammakara: [Kamma+kara+a] (ti) CL=7 [Dhāna. Dhāna, ṭī. 514.] One who is performing an activity. (Worker or labor).
kammakaraṇa:
[Kamma+karaṇa]  CL=10 Performance of a task or duty, doing work.
(a) (In Vinaya) Performing kamma, carrying out kamma.
(b) Performing parikamma. (This refers to repeated contemplation on a kammatthana object.)
kammakaraṇabhaya: [Kammakaraṇa+bhaya] (na) CL=7 Fear for working Kamma. Don"t desire to do Kamma.
kammakaraṇakāla: [Kammakaraṇa+kāla] (pu) CL=7 (A) A period of working. (B) A period of doing to increase.
kammakaraṇanānatta: [Kammakaraṇa+nānatta] (na) CL=7 Variety of punishment (or) pain. See - kammakāraṇanānatta.
kammakaraṇapatta: Kammakaraṇapatta seems to be departed from the Kammakāraṇapada. Tipi,5,318.
kammakaraṇasaṃvidhāna: Kammakaraṇapatta seems to be departed from the Kammakāraṇapada. Tipi,5,318.
kammakaraṇasukha: [Kammakaraṇa+sukha] (na) CL=7 Comfortable for working. Easy to work.
kammakaraṇasālā: [Kammakaraṇa+sālā] (thī) CL=7 A hall for working. Workshop.
kammakaraṇasīla: [Kamma+karaṇa+sīla] (ti) CL=7 One who is a habit of doing the job (or) an activity. See -  kammakāra.
kammakaraṇavelā: [Kammakaraṇa+velā] (thī) CL=7 A period of doing an activity (or) A period of working. See - Kammāyūhanakkhaṇa.
kammakaraṇavīriyābhāva: [Kammakaraṇa+vīriya+abhāva] (pu) CL=7 Lack of effort for working.
kammakaraṇicchā: [Kammakaraṇa+icchā] (thī) CL=7 Wishing for working (or) Desire to work.
kammakaraṇicchāvirahita: [Kammakaraṇa+icchā+virahita] (ti) CL=7 One who is free from the desire for working.
kammakaraṇānubhavanaṭṭhāna: The Kammakaraṇānubhavanaṭṭhāna seem departed from Kammakāraṇapada. Tipi,5,318.
kammakata: [Kamma+kata] (ti) CL=7 (1) One who the legal procedure is done for. (2) A Kamma what should be done.
kammakathā: [Kamma+kathā] (thī) CL=7 Words (sound) related to Kamma. Words (sound) that explain Kamma in detail and an elaborated version. The discussion of Kamma.
kammakattu: [Kamma+kattu] (pu) CL=7 A creator of Kamma. See original.
kammakilesa: [Kamma+kilesa] (pu) CL=7 (A) Kamma (deed). Kilesa. (In this the will as per Kamma. Takes 10 factors of Kilesa as per Kilesa). (B) Kamma that causes worry. (Four factors of Kamma that are Pāṇātipāta (killing another"s life), adinnādāna(stealing another object), kāmesumicchācāra (intercourse with another wife), musāvāda (say lie)).
kammakilesakāraṇa: [Kammakilesa+kāraṇa] (ti) CL=7 There is a reason that is Kilesa.
kammakilesapaccaya: [Kammakilesa+paccaya] (pu) CL=7 (1) A cause that is Kamma and Kilesa. (Ti0 (2) Has the cause that is Kamma and Kilesa.
kammakilesāvaraṇa: [Kammakilesa+āvaraṇa] (na) CL=7 Kamma and Kilesa that block the path which leads to the Deva realm, Magga, and Phala.
kammakiriyadassana: [Kamma+kiriya+dassana] (ti) CL=7 One who believes in Kamma and the fruit of Kamma.
kammakiriyavādī: [Kammakiriya+vada+ṇī] (ti) CL=7 One who believes in Kamma and the fruit of Kamma.
kammakiriyāphala: [Kamma+kiriyāphala] (na) CL=7 Kamma and the result (or) fruit of Kamma.
kammakkhamacitta: [Kammakkhama+citta] (ti) CL=7 One whose mind is capable of work.
kammakkhandhaka: [Kamma+khandhaka] (pu) CL=7 Khandhaka (Mahāvagga and Cūḷavagga, two books of the Vinaya Piṭaka) that criticizes Kamma such as Tajjanīya (concerning a rebuke; (a formal act of the saṅgha) expressing a rebuke).
kammakkhaya: [Kamma+khaya] (pu) CL=7 (1) Exhaustion of Kamma. (2) Arahattaphala that is an exhaustion of Kamma.
kammakkhayakara: [Kammakkhaya+kara+a] (ti) CL=7 (Magga wisdom, Magga willing) that causes to exhaust Kamma.
kammakkhayakarakamma: [Kammakkhayakara+kamma] (na) CL=7 Kamma that makes to wearing away of (the results of) action.
kammakkhayakaramana: [Kammakkhayakara+mana] (pu,na) CL=7 The mind that causes exhaustion of Kamma.
kammakkhayakarañāṇa: [Kammakkhayakara+ñāṇa] (na) CL=7 The wisdom that makes exhaustion of Kamma.
kammakkhayakarañāṇapharasu: [Kammakkhayakarañāṇa+pharasu] (pu) CL=7 The wisdom that is like an ax that makes exhaustion of Kamma.
kammakkhayakaraṇakamma: [Kammakkhayakaraṇa+kamma] (na) CL=7 Kamma that is doing to exhaust Kamma (or) Kamma that is making to wearing away of (the results of) action.
kammakkhayalakkhaṇa: [Kammakkhaya+lakkhaṇa] (na) CL=7 (1) The sign of the exhaustion of Kamma. (2) Has the nature of exhaustion of Kamma.
kammakkhayañāṇa: [Kammakkhaya+ñāṇa] (na) CL=7 The wisdom that causes exhaustion of Kamma.
kammakkhaṇa: [Kamma+khaṇa] (pu) CL=7 A period of doing (wholesome Kamma, unwholesome Kamma).
kammakkhitta: [Kamma+khitta] (ti) CL=7 It is thrown by Kamma.
kammakopa: [Kamma+kopa] (pu) CL=7 Distrubance of Kamma. (Distrubance of Kamma such as Upasampadakaṃma).
kammakopakāraṇa: [Kammakopa+kāraṇa] (na) CL=7 A cause of distrubance of Kamma.
kammakopasaṅkaṭṭhāna: [Kammakopasaṅkā+ṭhāna] (na) CL=7 A place of suspicion of disturbance of Kamma. See - Kammakopaṭṭhāna.
kammakopasaṅkā: [Kammakopa+saṅkā] (thī) CL=7 Doubt in the disturbance of Kamma.
kammakopavacana: [Kammakopa+vacana] (na) CL=7 Mentioning of disturbance of Kamma. Words (sound) that explain the disturbance of Kamma.
kammakopaṭṭhāna: [Kammakopa+ṭhāna] (na) CL=7 A place of disturbance of Kamma.
kammakoṭṭhāsa: [Kamma+koṭṭhāsa] (ti) CL=7 Has a portion that is Kamma.
kammakubbanta: [Kamma+kubbanta] (ti) CL=7 One who fulfills three obligations.
kammakāma: [Kamma+kamu+ṇa] (ti) CL=7 One who wishes to fulfill one’s obligation.
kammakāra: [Kamma+kara+ṇa] (ti) CL=7 [In Thī  kamma-kārī.] Doing work (or) job. (Worker).
kammakāraka: [Kamma+kāraka] (pu,na) CL=7 [Kamma+kara+ṇvu.] (1) Kammakāraka. (Ti) (2) (A) One who is doing work. (B) One who is doing Kamma.
kammakārakacitta: [Kammakāraka+citta] (na) CL=7 The mind that is doing an action.
kammakārakasatta: [Kammakāraka+satta] (pu) CL=7 A living being (or) creature who doing Kamma.
kammakārakasaṅgha: [Kammakāraka+saṅgha] (pu) CL=7 Sangha who is performing the legal action. See - Kārakasaṅgha.
kammakārakaviññāṇa: [Kammakāraka+viññāṇa] (na) CL=7 The mind that is doing meditation. (mind that meditates this five aggregate embodying of a being is not mine, not my wealth. not my body, etc.,).
kammakāravesa: [Kammakāra+ve] (pu) CL=7 The appearance of a worker.
kammakāraṇakāraka: [Kammakāraṇa+kāraka] (ti) CL=7 One who is doing punishment. (Executioner).
kammakāraṇapaccaya: [Kammakāraṇa+paccaya] (pu) CL=7 A cause that is punishment (or) torture.
kammakāraṇika: [Kammakāraṇa+ika] (ti) CL=7 One who is doing punishment. (Executioner, King of the Hell. A guard of Hell).
kammakāraṇikasatta: [Kammakāraṇika+satta] (pu) CL=7 A living being who is doing torture (or) punishment.
kammakāraṇākāraṇa: [Kammakāraṇā+kāraṇa] (na) CL=7 A cause of punishment. See - Kammakāraṇakkhaṇa.
kammalakkhaṇa: [Kamma+lakkhaṇa] (na) CL=7 (1) Characterized by one’s actions. (2) The auspicious sign that is Kamma (deeds). (The recognized sign that is Kamma. Vimati). See original. (Ti) (3) One who has the recognized sign of Kamma. (One who is doing unwholesome deeds, is called Bāla. One who is doing wholesome deeds, is called Paṇḍita. Therefore that person has the recognized sign of Kamma (Kammalakkhaṇa)).
kammalakkhaṇapatta: [Kammalakkhaṇa+patta] (ti) CL=7 Reached a state that is characterized by one"s deed.
kammalakkhaṇappatta: [Kammalakkhaṇa+patta] (ti) CL=7 Reached a state that is characterized by one"s deed.
kammalakkhaṇavinicchaya: [Kammalakkhaṇa+vinicchaya] (pu) CL=7 The discrimination of the characteristics of Kamma.
kammalakkhaṇekadesa: [Kammalakkhaṇa+ekadesa] (pu) CL=7 A part of the characteristics of Kamma.
kammamaggagatika: [Kamma+magga+gatika] (ti) CL=7 Similar to the path of Kamma.
kammamana: [Kamma+mana] (pu,na) CL=7 Mind activity (or) action of the mind.
kammamutta: [Kamma+mutta] (ti) CL=7 Released from work (or) One who has leave from work.
kammamūla: [Kamma+mūla] (na) CL=7 The capital of Kamma (or) the capital that is Kamma (deeds).
kammamūlaka: [Kamma+mūla+ka] (ti) CL=7 Kamma that is a root cause.
kammanaya: [Kamma+naya] (pu) CL=7 The method (or) mode (or) manner that causes Kamma. Kammanaya.
kammanayadvaya: [Kammanaya+dvaya] (na) CL=7 A pair of Kammanayadvaya (or) A pair of methods that cause Kamma.
kammanibandhana: [Kamma+nibandhana] (ti) CL=7 One who is bounded by actions.
kammanibbattakkhandha: [Kammanibbatta+khandha] (pu) CL=7 The aggregates embodying of a being that is caused by Kamma.
kammanibbattanānākaraṇa: [Kammanibbatta+nānākaraṇa] (na) CL=7 Has differentiations that are produced through Kamma.
kammanidāna: [Kamma+nidāna] (na) CL=7 (1) An origin that is Kamma. See - Kammanidānasaṅkhaya. (Ti) (2) A cause that is Kamma.
kammanidānasambhava: [Kammanidāna+sambhava] (ti) CL=7 That is a cause (or) an origin of Kamma.
kammanidānasaṅkhaya: [Kammanidāna+saṅkhaya] (pu) CL=7 Exhaustion of cause of Kamma.
kammanikantikkhaṇa: [Kamma+nikanti+khaṇa] (pu) CL=7 A moment of arising Kamma. A moment of delight in life.
kammaniketavantu: [Kammaniketa+vantu] (ti) CL=7 An activity that is a home (or) an origin.
kammanimitta: [Kamma+nimitta] (na) CL=7 The sign of Kamma. The intention of Kamma. (In killing a cow, the unwholesome deed (killing) is Kamma. Cow element that arises in the sense this Kamma that is the sign of Kamma. Building and worshiping the Pagoda that is wholesome deeds which is Kamma, a Pagoda element that arises in that Kamma that is the sign of Kamma).
kammanimittārammaṇa: [Kammanimitta+ārammaṇa] (ti) CL=7 An object of the sense that is the sign of Kamma.
kammanipphatti: [Kamma+nipphatti] (thī) CL=7 The completion of Kamma (or) happened Kamma.
kammanipphādana: [Kamma+nipphādana] (na) CL=7 Causes the completion of an activity.
kammanirodha: [Kamma+nirodha] (pu) CL=7 The exhaustion of Kamma that is Nibbāna.
kammanirodhagāminīpaṭipadā: [Kammanirodhagāminī+paṭipadā] (thī) CL=7 The practice that leads to Nibbāna that is a place of exhaustion of Kamma.
kammanissanda: [Kamma+nissanda] (pu) CL=7 Consequences of kamma (or) the fruit of Kamma.
kammanittharaṇasamattha: [Kamma+nittharaṇa+samattha] (ti) CL=7 One who is able to do a state of overcome of Kamma (volitional action).
kammaniya: [Kamma+niya] (ti) CL=7 [Kamme sādhu kammaniyaṃ. Moga, 4. 73.] Workable (or) ready to work.
kammaniyabhāvūpagamana: [Kammaniya+bhāva+upagamana] (na) CL=7 Going towards a workable state (or) Approaching a ready state (such as mentally).
kammaniyacitta: [Kammaniya+citta]  CL=9 The mind that is fit for the action/work. See kallacitta.
kammaniyalakkhaṇa: [Kammaniya+lakkhaṇa] (ti) CL=7 Has the auspicious sign of ready to work the matter (or) the auspicious sign of workable (mind).
kammaniyamarahita: [Kamma+niyama+rahita]  CL=9 Absence of the limitation- marking of Kamma.
kammaniyappatta: [+kammaniya+patta] (ti) CL=7 Reached a ready state (or) reached a workable state.
kammaniyasabhāva: [Kammaniya+sabhāva] (ti) CL=7 Has a good (or) workable nature of (activity).
kammaniyākāra: [Kammaniya+ākāra] (pu) CL=7 A ready manner (or) workable manner.
kammaniyāma: [Kamma+niyāma] (pu) CL=7 Law of Kamma (or) order of Kamma.
kammaniyāmasiddha: [Kammaniyāma+siddha] (ti) CL=7 Happened with an order of Kamma.
kammanta: [Kamma+anta] (ti) CL=7 (1) Workplace. (2) the matter (or) work (or) job. (3) One who is acting unethically. See - Asappurisakammanta. (4) Having intention. Kamma (activity). See - Pāpakammanta.
kammantabherī: [Kammanta+bherī] (thī) CL=7 A kettle drum that is striving to start work. See - Kammantakiriya.
kammantadāsa: [Kammanta+dāsa] (pu) CL=7 Slave for business activity (or) Slave.
kammantagāma: [Kammanta+gāma] (pu) CL=7 The village of the slaves. The workers" village.
kammantapekkhaka: [Kammanta+apekkha+ka] (ti) CL=7 One who is looking for actions.
kammantappayojana: [Kammanta+payojana] (na) CL=7 Compared to various actions. Carries on the work.
kammantara: [Kamma+antara] (na) CL=7 (1) An action (or) one Kamma. Another action (or) Kamma. (2) Different kinds of Kamma.
kammantaracaraṇa: [Kammantara+caraṇa] (na) CL=7 Wandering on one Kamma. Wandering on another Kamma.
kammantaracārī: [Kammantara+cara+ṇī] (ti) CL=7 Used to wander (or) live in a Kamma.
kammantaravipākantara: [Kammantara+vipākantara] (na) CL=7 Various results of the various Kamma.
kammantaravipākantarajānanañāṇa: [Kammantaravipākantara+jānana+ñāṇa] (na) CL=7 The wisdom that understands the various results of various Kamma.
kammantarāya: [Kamma+antarāya] (pu) CL=7 The danger (or) an obstacle that is Kamma. Kammantarāya.
kammantarāyika: [Kamma+antarāyika] (ti) CL=7 Kamma that gives the result that is an obstacle. Kamma is a danger. (Kamma that are killing mother, killing father, killing Arahant, doing blood leaking Lord Buddha, making cause dissension among Sangha. These five actions (five Kammas) are called kammantarāya).
kammantarūpalakkhaṇa: [Kammantara+upalakkhaṇa] (ti) CL=7 Has the auspicious sign that is another Kamma.
kammantasampadā: [Kammanta+sampadā] (thī) CL=7 Success in action. (Observes avoidance of killing  the life of being that is the wholesome deed that is called kammantasampadā).
kammantasamīpa: [Kammanta+samīpa] (pu) CL=7 Near the place of work (or) close to the workplace.
kammantavipatti: [Kammanta+vipatti] (thī) CL=7 Failure in action. (Doing the unwholesome deed that is killing a life of being which is called Kammavipatti).
kammantavāvaṭa: [Kammanta+vi+ā+vaṭa+a] (ti) CL=7 One who is striving for an action.
kammantika: [Kammanta+ika] (ti) CL=7 One who is related to action (or) a laborer.
kammantikamanussa: [Kammantika+manussa] (pu) CL=7 One who is a worker. A laborer.
kammantābhinivesa: [Kammanta+abhinivesa] (ti) CL=7 One who is insisting on work.
kammantādhiṭṭhāna: [Kammanta+adhiṭṭhāna] (na) CL=7 Fixing the mind on obligated action.
kammantādhiṭṭhāyaka: [Kammanta+adhiṭṭhāya+ka] (ti) CL=7 One who is standing firmly on an action (or) One who is arranging the work.
kammanānatta: [Kammanānā+tta] (na) CL=7 As a manifoldness of Kamma. See - Kammanānattamūlaka.
kammanānattamūlaka: [Kammanānatta+mūla+ka] (ti) CL=7 A manifoldness of Kamma that is an origin.
kammanānatā: [Kammanānā+tā] (thī) CL=7 As a manifoldness of Kamma.
kammanānākaraṇa: [Kamma+nānākaraṇa] (na) CL=7 Variation due to Kamma. Manifoldness of Kamma.
kammanānāsaṃvāsaka: [Kamma+nānāsaṃvāsa+ka] (ti) CL=7 One who is living together variously by the power of Ukkhepanīyakamma (the formal act of suspension).
kammapabandha: [Kamma+pabandha] (pu) CL=7 Continuity of Kamma (action). See - Kammavaṭṭa.
kammapaccaya: [Kamma+paccaya] (pu) CL=7 (1) A cause that is a companion of a Kamma (action). (2) A cause that is Kamma. Kammapaccaya. (3) As a state of a cause of Kamma. The power of Kamma. (Ti) (4) Has a cause that is Kamma.
kammapaccayacittasamuṭṭhāna: [Kammapaccayacitta+samuṭṭhāna] (ti) CL=7 Mind that is supported by Kamma (action) which is a cause (form).
kammapaccayaniddesa: [Kammapaccaya+niddesa] (pu) CL=7 Explains Kammapaccaya (a cause of Kamma) in detail and an elaborated version.
kammapaccayautusamuṭṭhāna: [Kammapaccayautu+samuṭṭhāna]  CL=10 Kamma-accompanied, having kamma as a companion, having utu (temperature/season) as the cause that is conditioned by kamma, having utu as the cause that arises dependent on kamma (such as the wheel-treasure, celestial gardens, heavenly mansions, and other utu-born materiality conditioned by kamma).
kammapaccayavibhaṅga: [Kammapaccaya+vibhaṅga] (pu) CL=7 Analysis of Kammapaccaya (a cause of Kamma). It explains Kammapaccaya in detail and elaborated version.
kammapaccayākāra: [Kammapaccaya+ākāra] (pu) CL=7 A cause that is Kammapaccaya (a cause of Kamma). The matter of supporting Kammapaccaya.
kammapahāna: [Kamma+pahāna] (na) CL=7 (A) Abandoning of Kamma. (B) Giving up an action. Giving up the work.
kammapakativibhāga: [Kamma+pakati+vibhāga] (pu) CL=7 Analyzed the natural state of Kamma (Deceit of Viṣṇu).
kammapalibodha: [Kamma+palibodha] (pu) CL=7 Doing for action. An obstacle that is an action. (For the sake of meditative Yogī who is doing on building a monastery, building a home that is an obstacle for Kammaṭṭhāna).
kammapariyosāna: [Kamma+pariyāsāna] (na) CL=7 (A) The end of Kamma. Completion of an action. (B) Completion (an end) of (Vinaya) Kamma.
kammapariyosānāpekkha: [Kammapariyosāna+apekkha] (ti) CL=7 Longing for completion (an end) of (Vinaya) Kamma.
kammapariḷāhūpasamana: [Kammapariḷāha+upasamana] (na) CL=7 Cause to cease worry that is Kamma.
kammapariṇāma: [Kamma+pariṇāma] (pu) CL=7 Matured Kamma (or) revolution of deeds. See - Kammavivaṭṭa.
kammapariṇāmita: [Kamma+pariṇāmita] (ti) CL=7 Changed into Kamma (or) Fall into Kamma. is arranged by Kamma.
kammapatha: [Kamma+patha] (pu) CL=7 The course of action (or) path of action. Kamma that leads to Sugati(good destination), and Duggati (bad destination).
kammapathabheda: [Kammapatha+bheda] (pu) CL=7 (A) Variety of paths of action. (B) Disturbing of the path of action.
kammapathabhedaka: [Kammapathabheda+kara+kvi] (ti) CL=7 Causes a variety of paths of action.
kammapathacetanā: [Kammapatha+cotanā] (thī) CL=7 Having intention to course of action.
kammapathadesanā: [Kammapatha+desanā] (thī) CL=7 Preaching Kammapatha (path of action). Preaching the Four Noble Truths base on Kammapatha.
kammapathakathā: [Kammapatha+kathā] (thī) CL=7 The words (sound) that explain Kammapatha (path of action).
kammapathakoṭṭhāsa: [Kammapatha+koṭṭhāsa] (pu) CL=7 A portion of Kammapatha (path of action).
kammapathakoṭṭhāsika: [Kammapathakoṭṭhāsa+ika] (ti) CL=7 Related to a portion of Kammapatha (path of action).
kammapathamukha: [Kammapatha+mukha] (na) CL=7 Makes first and foremost Kammapatha (path of action). See - Kammapathadesanā.
kammapathapariyāpanna: [Kammapatha+pariyāpanna] (ti) CL=7 Include in Kammapatha (path of action).
kammapathappatta: [Kammapatha+patta] (ti) CL=7 Reached the path of action.
kammapathappatti: [Kammapatha+patti] (thī) CL=7 Reaching the path of action.
kammapathappavatti: [Kammapatha+pavatti] (thī) CL=7 The occurrence of the course of kamma.
kammapatharāsi: [Kammapatha+rāsi] (pu) CL=7 A pile of course of action.
kammapathasambandhavibhāvanā: [Kammapatha+sambandha+vibhāvanā] (thī) CL=7 Showing the relation of course of action.
kammapathasammādiṭṭhi: [Kammapatha+sammādiṭṭhi] (thī) CL=7 The wisdom that is understanding the path of action well. (that is the wholesome deed that is a cause which as well leads to a good destination, as well the wealth of that place,  and the unwholesome deed that is a cause which as well leads to a bad destination, as well the suffering of that place).
kammapathasampatta: [Kammapatha+sampatta] (ti) CL=7 Reached the mode of action.
kammapathasaṃsandana: [Kammapatha+saṃsandana] (na) CL=7 Explaining the path of action. ( explains the path of action by as well the power of the same name, the power of not giving up the name, the power of arising in Phassa Dvāra).
kammapathatāvacana: [Kammapathatā+vacana] (na) CL=7 The words (sound) that explain the path of action.
kammapathavināsaka: [Kammapatha+vināsa+ka] (pu) CL=7 Destruction of the path of action.
kammapathavisesa: [Kammapatha+visesa] (pu) CL=7 The superior state of the path of action. See - Kammapathavināsaka.
kammapathavisesakara: [Kammapathavisesa+kara+a] (ti) CL=7 Doing the superior state of the path of action. See - Kammapathabhedaka.
kammapathaṭṭhāniya: [Kammapathaṭṭhāna+iya] (ti) CL=7 Related to the path of action. Reached the path of action.
kammapathānantariyakamma: [Kammapatha+ānantariyakamma] (na) CL=7 Ānantariyakamma (action with immediate results (matricide, etc.)) that is reached the mode of action.
kammapatthanā: [Kamma+patthanā] (thī) CL=7 Intending (or) longing that is Kamma.
kammapavatta: [Kamma+pavatta] (na) CL=7 Happening Kamma in succession.  continuous happening Kamma.
kammapavattita: [Kamma+pavattita] (ti) CL=7 Set going Kamma (or) Causes Kamma.
kammapaṭippassaddhimattāpekkha: [Kammapaṭippassaddhimatta+apekkha] (ti) CL=7 Longing for cessation of Kamma.
kammapaṭippassaddhividhāna: [Kammapaṭippassaddhi+vidhāna] (na) CL=7 The arrangement of cessation of Kamma.
kammapaṭisandhivavatthāna: [Kamma+paṭisandhivavatthāna] (na) CL=7 Distinguishes the state of rebirth-linking by Kamma.
kammaphala: [Kamma+phala] (na) CL=7 (A) The result of kamma. (B) The result of kamma. Kammaphala Faith - Look.
kammaphaladiṭṭhi: [Kammaphala+diṭṭhi] (thī) CL=7 The wisdom that is understanding the result (or) fruit of Kamma.
kammaphalakittanamukha: [Kammaphalakittana+mukha] (na) CL=7 Making first and foremost an explanation of the fruit of Kamma. See - Vaṇibbaka.
kammaphalapaccakkhabhāva: [Kammaphala+paccakkhabhāva] (pu) CL=7 The perception of the result of Kamma.
kammaphalapaccakkhakaraṇa: [Kammaphala+paccakkhakaraṇa] (na) CL=7 Making visible the fruit (or) result of Kamma.
kammaphalapaṭikkhepa: [Kammaphala+paṭikkhepa] (pu) CL=7 Rejection of the fruit of Kamma.
kammaphalasaddahana: [Kammaphala+saddahana] (na) CL=7 Belief in the result (or) fruit of Kamma.
kammaphalasaddhā: [Kammaphala+saddhā] (thī) CL=7 Belief in Kamma and the fruit of Kamma.
kammaphalasaddhānugata: [Kammaphalasaddhā+anugata] (ti) CL=7 Always follows after belief in Kamma and the result of Kamma.
kammaphalasambandha: [Kammaphala+sambandha] (pu) CL=7 Related to the result of Kamma.
kammaphalasaññita: [Kammaphala+saññita] (ti) CL=7 It is so-called the fruit of Kamma.
kammaphalavavatthita: [Kammaphala+vavatthita] (ti) CL=7 Analyzed (or) defined the fruit of Kamma.
kammaphalavisaya: [Kammaphala+visaya] (ti) CL=7 Senses (or) intends on the result of Kamma.
kammaphalavādī: [Kammaphala+vada+ṇī]  CL=9 [Kammaphalavāda+ī] One who believes in 'Kamma and the result of Kamma'. One who has the belief of Kammaphala.
kammaphaluppatti: [Kammaphala+uppatti] (thī) CL=7 Arises the result of Kamma.
kammaphalūpabhoga: [Kammaphala+upabhoga] (pu) CL=7 Enjoys the result of Kamma.
kammaphalūpaga: [Kammaphala+upaga(upa+gamu+kvi)] (ti) CL=7 Approached the result of Kamma. One who is undergoing the result of Kamma. See - Attakammaphalūpaga.
kammaphalūpajīvī: [Kammaphala+upa+jīva+ṇī] (pu) CL=7 (A) One who is making a living base on the fruit of Kamma. (2) One who is making a living base on the result of work.
kammappabandha: [Kamma+pabandha] (pu) CL=7 Continuity of Kamma. See - Kammavaṭṭa.
kammappahāna: [Kamma+pahāna] (na) CL=7 (A) Abandoning Kamma. (B) Rejection deeds. Giving up work.
kammappamukha: [Kamma+pamukha] (na) CL=7 Making first and foremost Kamma (or) headed by Kamma.
kammappasuta: [Kamma+pasuta] (ti) CL=7 (1) One who is making effort wholesome deeds. (2) One who is making a thorough study of action (or) activity.
kammappatta: [Kamma+patta] (ti) CL=7 Entitled to participate in the formal act.
kammappavacanīya: [Kamma+pavacanīya] (ti) CL=7 (A) Having deeds (Kamma) that preach. One who preaches deeds (Kamma). (B) Peached deeds in the past. See original.
kammappavacanīyasaññā: [Kammappavacanīyā+saññā] (thī) CL=7 (1) The perception of denoting an action. (Ti) Has the perception that is denoting an action. See - Kammappavacanīya.
kammappavacanīyayoga: [Kammappavacanīya+yoga] (pu) CL=7 Yoking with an action. See - Kammappavacanīyayutta.
kammappavacanīyayutta: [Kammappavacanīya+yutta]  CL=9 Connected with the Upasāra/prefix and nipāta/indeclinable particles called Kammappavacanīya.
kammappavatta: [Kamma+pavatta] (na) CL=7 Arising Kamma continuously. The continuity of Kamma.
kammappaṭisaraṇa: [Kamma+paṭisaraṇa] (ti) CL=7 One who is supported by deeds.
kammapādañatti: [Kamma+pāda+ñatti]  CL=9 Declaration which is the foundation of the Kammavāvā.
kammarata: [Kamma+rata] (ti) CL=7 Enjoying work (or) delighting in activity.
kammaraññā: [Kamma+rāja+nā] (pu) CL=7 The King that is Kamma (deeds or activity).
kammarāja: [Kamma+rāja] (pu) CL=7 Kamma is the leader like a King. See - Kammaraññā.
kammarūpa: [Kamma+rūpa] (na) CL=7 Kammarūpa. (The form that is finished with Kammapaccaya (the requisites of action).
kammasabhāga: [Kamma+sabhāga] (ti) CL=7 Same Kamma (or) Similar to Kamma.
kammasabhāva: [Kamma+sabhāva] (ti) CL=7 One who has a normal behavior of Kamma. See - Kammasacca.
kammasacca: [Kamma+sacca] (ti) CL=7 One who has a normal behavior of Kamma.
kammasahajāta: [Kamma+sahajāta] (ti) CL=7 It arises at the same time as Kamma.
kammasahāya: [Kamma+sahāya] (pu) CL=7 (1) Workmate. A friend from work. (2) A companion of Kamma. (Ti) (3) Has a companion that is Kamma.
kammasajja: [Kamma+sajja] (ti) CL=7 One who prepares to do work. One who prepares to fight a battle. One who is holding a weapon.
kammasamaya: [Kamma+samaya] (pu) CL=7 Time of physical activity. See original.
kammasamaṅgī: [Kamma+samaṅgī] (ti) CL=7 One who is having the quality of physical activity. (A living being who does not attain the Arahattaphala period, has the fruit of Kamma which is an accumulative Kamma in the past whose is called a kammasamaṅgī person).
kammasamaṅgīpuggala: [Kammasamaṅgī+puggala] (pu) CL=7 A person who is endowed with Kamma.
kammasambandha: [Kamma+sambandha] (pu) CL=7 Related to Kamma. Connected to Kammakāraka (doing the action).
kammasambhava: [Kamma+sambhava] (pu) CL=7 (1) Produced by Kamma. (Ti) (2) Has a cause that is Kamma.
kammasambhāra: [Kamma+sambhāra] (pu) CL=7 [Kamma+kammasambhāra] (1) A pile (or) an accumulation that is Kamma. (2) A supported component of Kamma.
kammasambhāriñjitapaccaya: [Kammasambhāra+iñjita+paccaya] (pu) CL=7 A cause of agitation of an accumulation Kamma. See - Iñjitapaccaya.
kammasambhūta: [Kamma+sambhūta] (ti) CL=7 It arises due to Kamma.
kammasampadā: [Kamma+sampadā] (thī) CL=7 Success in action. The completed Kamma.
kammasampatti: [Kamma+sampatti] (thī) CL=7 The success of legal action. The success Kamma.
kammasampattidīpana: [Kammasampatti+dīpana] (na) CL=7 Explanation of success of legal action.
kammasamudāya: [Kamma+samudāya] (pu) CL=7 A collection of actions. See - Kammarāsi.
kammasamuṭṭhāna: [Kamma+samuṭṭhāna] (ti) CL=7 Kamma that is a cause. It arises due to Kamma.
kammasamuṭṭhānapaveṇī: [Kammasamuṭṭhāna+paveṇī] (thī) CL=7 Arisen from Kamma in succession.
kammasamuṭṭhānarūpa: [Kammasamuṭṭhāna+rūpa] (na) CL=7 A physical body has arisen from Kamma.
kammasamuṭṭhānarūpakalāpa: [Kammasamuṭṭhānarūpa+kalāpa] (pu) CL=7 The aggregates embodying of a being that arises from Kamma.
kammasamuṭṭhānarūpakāya: [Kammasamuṭṭhānarūpa+kāya] (pu) CL=7 All forms that arise from Kamma. Arises forms due to Kamma.
kammasamuṭṭhānasambandha: [Kammasamuṭṭhāna+sambandha] (ti) CL=7 Connection with a form that has arisen from Kamma.
kammasamuṭṭhānikakāya: [Kammasamuṭṭhānika+kāya] (pu) CL=7 All the forms that have arisen from Kamma.
kammasamādāna: [Kamma+samādāna] (na) CL=7 The undertaking of activity (or) doing of a deed.
kammasamādānapucchā: [Kammasamādāna+pucchā] (thī) CL=7 Asking for an undertaking of activity. Asking for making a living.
kammasamānārammaṇa: [Kammasamāna+ārammaṇa] (ti) CL=7 A sense of an object that is similar to Kamma.
kammasamārambha: [Kamma+samārambha] (pu) CL=7 undertaking activity (or) initiating action (or) performing deeds. See - Kammasamārambhaṭṭhāyī.
kammasamārambhaṭṭhāyī: [Kammasamārambha+ṭhā+ṇī] (ti) CL=7 One who is continuing through initiating action.
kammasannissita: [Kamma+sannissita] (ti) CL=7 (The result) that based on Kamma.
kammasantati: [Kamma+santati] (thī) CL=7 An uninterrupted succession of Kamma.
kammasarikkhakaphala: [Kammasarikkhaka+phala] (na) CL=7 The result (or) fruit that is similar in consequence to the deed done.
kammasarikkhakavipāka: [Kammasarikkhaka+vipāka] (pu) CL=7 The result (or) fruit that is similar in consequence to the deed done.
kammasarikkhakavipākadassana: [Kammasarikkhakavipāka+dassana] (na) CL=7 Showing the result (or) fruit that is similar in consequence to the deed done.
kammasarikkhakavisaya: [Kammasarikkhaka+visaya] (pu) CL=7 The objective field that is similar to Kamma.
kammasata: [Kamma+sata] (na) CL=7 The presence of actions. Many actions.
kammasaya: [Kamma+saka] (ti) CL=7 [Ka does ya]. One whose wealth is Kamma (or) One who is owner of action. See - Kammassaka.
kammasañcodita: [Kamma+sañcodita] (ti) CL=7 One who is instigated by Kamma.
kammasaṃsaṭṭhasahāya: [Kammasaṃsaṭṭha+sahāya] (pu) CL=7 A companion associated with Kamma.
kammasaṃyoga: [Kamma+saṃyoga] (pu) CL=7 Associated with doing the action.
kammasaṅgahābhāva: [Kamma+saṅgaha+abhāva] (pu) CL=7 Lack of counting Kamma. (Sammukhāvinaya (face to face settlement) that is not Kamma).
kammasaṅkara: [Kamma+saṅkara]  CL=10 Mixing or blending of kamma (formal acts). (This refers to the view of some teachers who say that minor acts (lahuka-kamma) such as the appointment of a lodging assignor (senasanagahapaka), which are usually performed by apalokanakamma or nattidutiyakamma, can also be performed by natticatutthakamma. This view is considered a mixing of different types of formal acts.)
kammasaṅkaradosa: [Kammasaṅkara+dosa] (pu) CL=7 The fault (or) flaw that is mixing with Kamma.
kammasaṅkhepa: [Kamma+saṅkhepa] (pu) CL=7 Layer of Kamma (actions). A mass of Kamma. Five factors of past causes that are Avijjā (illusion), saṅkhāra (volitional formation), taṇhā (craving), upādāna(clinging), and bhava(life). Five factors of present causes that are Taṇhā, Upādāna, Bhava, Avijjā, and Saṅkhāra. These 10 factors are called Kammasaṅkhepa. See also - Saṅkhepa.
kammasaṅkhāra:
[Kamma+saṅkhāra]  CL=9 (a) Sankhara that is called kamma, kamma that forms and arranges.
(b) Kamma, sankhara. Here, "kamma" refers to patisandhi-janaka-kamma (rebirth-generating kamma). "Sankhara" refers to phassa (contact), cetana (volition), and other sankharas that arise together with maranasanna-javana (near-death impulsion) and have the power to project (into a new existence).
kammasaṅkhāranati: [Kamma+saṅkhāra+nati] (thī) CL=7 Kamma, volition formation, and craving or illusion.
kammasaṅkhāranāmita: [Kamma+saṅkhāra+nāmita] (ti) CL=7 Bent by Kamma (action) and Saṅkhāra (volitional formation). See - Kammasaṅkhāranati.
kammasiddhi: [Kamma+siddhi] (thī) CL=7 (A) Completion of the action. Success work. (B) Accomplishment of Kamma.
kammasippī: [Kamma+sippī]  CL=9 Specialist in actions (such as kalā 64). See Abbhuddhunanta.
kammassaka: [Kamma+saka] (ti) CL=7 One who is owner of actions. See original.
kammassakatacitta: [Kammassakatā+citta] (na) CL=7 The mind that understands the act of being the owner of one’s actions (or) the fact that actions are one"s property.
kammassakatapaññā: [Kammassakatā+paññā] (thī) CL=7 Kammassakata Wisdom (the wisdom that understands the fact that actions are one"s property).
kammassakataññāṇa: [Kammassakatā+ñāṇa] (na) CL=7 The wisdom that understands the fact that actions are one"s property.
kammassakataññāṇadassana: [Kammassakatā+dassana] (na) CL=7 Sight (or) vision of Kammassakata Wisdom (the wisdom that understands the fact that actions are one"s property).
kammassakataññāṇappavatti: [Kammassakataññāṇa+pavatti] (thī) CL=7 Occurrence of  Kammassakata Wisdom (the wisdom that understands the fact that actions are one"s property).
kammassakataññāṇasati: [Kammassasataññāṇa+sati] (thī) CL=7 Mindfulness that is related to Kammassakata Wisdom (the wisdom that understands the fact that actions are one"s property).
kammassakatañāṇa: [Kammassakatā+ñāṇa] (na) CL=7 The wisdom that understands the fact that actions are one"s property. See original.
kammassakatā: [Kammassaka+tā] (thī) CL=7 One who understands the facts his actions are his property.
kammassakatādassana: [Kammassakatā+dassana] (na) CL=7 (1) The spiritual vision of wisdom of Kammassakatā (fact of being the owner of one’s actions). (Ti) (2) One who has a wisdom that understands the fact of being the owner of one’s actions.
kammassakatādiṭṭhi: [Kammassakatā+diṭṭhi] (thī) CL=7 The belief of Kammassakatā (fact of being the owner of one’s actions).
kammassakatādiṭṭhika: [Kammassakatādiṭṭhi+ika] (ti) CL=7 One who believes in the fact of being the owner of one"s actions.
kammassakatādīpana: [Kammassakatā+dīpana] (na) CL=7 Explanation of the fact of being the owner of one"s actions.
kammassakatājānanapaññā: [Kammassakatā+jānanapaññā] (thī) CL=7 The wisdom that understands the fact of being the owner of one"s actions.
kammassakatājānanañāṇa: [Kammassakatā+jānanañāṇa] (na) CL=7 The wisdom that understands the fact of being the owner of one"s actions.
kammassakatālakkhaṇa: [Kammassakatā+lakkhaṇa] (na) CL=7 Has the auspicious sign that is the fact that actions are one’s property.
kammassakatāpaccavekkhaṇa: [Kammassakatā+paccavekkhaṇa] (thī,na) CL=7 Contemplates the fact that his actions are his own property.
kammassakatāpaccavekkhaṇapadaṭṭhāna: [Kammassakatāpaccavekkhaṇa+padaṭṭhāna] (ti) CL=7 There is a proximate cause for contemplation on the fact that actions are one"s property.
kammassakatāpaññā: [Kammassakatā+paññā] (thī) CL=7 The wisdom that is the fact that actions are one"s property.
kammassakatāsammādiṭṭhi: [Kammassakatā+sammādiṭṭhi] (thī) CL=7 The wisdom that understands the fact that actions are one"s property.
kammassakatāvabodhana: [Kammassakatā+avabodhana] (na) CL=7 Understanding the fact that actions are one"s property.
kammassakatāñāṇa: [Kammassakatā+ñāṇa] (na) CL=7 The wisdom that understands the fact that actions are one"s property. See original.
kammassakatāñāṇabala: [Kammassakatāñāṇa+bala] (na) CL=7 The power of wisdom that understands the fact that actions are one"s property.
kammassakāse: [Kamma+saka+se]  CL=9 "Se" is the indeclinable particle that is inserted. See also gatāse.] Having kamma as one"s own property; one.
kammassāda: [Kamma+assāda] (pu) CL=7 Pleasure in actions. Enjoys fighting in a battle.
kammassāmighara: [Kammassāmi+ghara] (na) CL=7 A building for the owner of a business.
kammassāmī: [Kamma+sāmī] (pu) CL=7 There should also be Rassa and kammasā(ssā)mi. Saṃ dhanaṃ assatthīti sāmī, dīghādi, rassante sāmipi. Dhāna, ṭī. 725. Moga, 4. 90. Dhammassāmī pada that is similar to Kammassāmī to follow Sakkata, they are the words doing double. Owner of a business.
kammasādhana: [Kamma+sādhana] (na) CL=7 (1) Kammasādha, kammasādhana. (Kammasādhana that is an end with Kitapaccaya). (Ti) (2) Carrying out actions.
kammasālā: [Kamma+sālā] (thī) CL=7 A building that is a workplace (or) workshop.
kammasāmī: [Kamma+sāmī] (pu) CL=7 There should also be Rassa and kammasā(ssā)mi. Saṃ dhanaṃ assatthīti sāmī, dīghādi, rassante sāmipi. Dhāna, ṭī. 725. Moga, 4. 90. Dhammassāmī pada that is similar to Kammassāmī to follow Sakkata, they are the words doing double]. Owner of a business.
kammasīsa: [Kamma+sīsa] (na) CL=7 Making the front line (or) the head for Kamma.
kammasūla: [Kamma+sūla] (pu,na) CL=7 The skewer that is Kamma. Kamma skewer. See - Kammasūlāvuta.
kammasūlāvuta: [Kammasūla+āvuta] (ti) CL=7 One who is strung by a skewer.
kammattayaniyama: [Kammattaya+niyama] (pu) CL=7 Defined the three deeds (or) actions.
kammattha: [Kamma+attha] (pu) CL=7 (1) Meaning of Kamma (action). (translates 'as in (or) to ' in Kāraka. translates 'should' as a verb. (Ti) (2) Has a meaning of Kamma.
kammatthadīpana: [Kammattha+dīpana] (thī,na) CL=7 Explanation of the meaning of Kamma.
kammatthapada: [Kammattha+pada] (na) CL=7 A word (or) phrase that is the meaning of Kamma.
kammatthāpekkha: [Kammattha+apekkha] (ti) CL=7 Looking for (or) longing for the meaning of Kamma (action).
kammavacana: [Kamma+vacana] (na) CL=7 (1) The word (sound) that is Kamma. Kammasaddā. (2) Talking Kaṃ(kammakāraka : doing the action (or) worker).
kammavacanicchā: [Kammavacana+icchā] (thī) CL=7 Wishing for Kamma (action or work).
kammavagga: [Kamma+vagga] (pu) CL=7 Kammavagga. A collection of Kamma. All of the sum of four Kamma. That is Apalokanakamma((Vinaya) legal procedure to obtain permission; the act of giving notice), ñattikamma((Vinaya) legal procedure with one motion; legal action with only an initial statement), Uttidutiyakamma, and ñatticatutthakamma ((Vinaya) legal procedure with motion and three announcements).
kammavasippatta: [Kamma+vasī+patta] (ti) CL=7 Reached a state of having the power of Kamma. Reached a state of mastery Kamma.
kammavasitāsambhava: [Kammavasita+asambhava] (pu) CL=7 Not arising by the power of Kamma.
kammavasānuga: [Kamma+vasānuga] (ti) CL=7 One who always follows after the desire of Kamma.
kammavavatthāna: [Kamma+vavatthāna] (na) CL=7 Defines Kamma. Distinguished as Kāyakamma (physical action), Vacīkamma (Verbal action), and Manokamma (mental action).
kammavaṭṭa: [Kamma+vaṭṭa] (pu,na) CL=7 Kamma that arises the fruit (or) result of Kamma (as a circle). The continuity of Kamma. A round of Kamma. (As well the present willing that is being as an action which is a cause for rebirth-linking of the next existence, as well the rebirth-linking of present existence that arose due to intention in the past, these are called Kammavaṭṭa (round of Kamma (or) phase of Kamma). The five factors of Avijjā (illusion), Saṅkhāra (volitional formation), Taṇhā (craving), Upādāna (clinging), and Kammabhava (Kammically accumulative existence) that arise with companions. That is the so-called Kammavaṭṭa ( round of kamma (or) phase of kamma)).
kammavaṭṭakkhaya: [Kammavaṭṭa+khaya] (pu) CL=7 The cessation of Kammavaṭṭa ( round of kamma (or) phase of kamma)).
kammavaṭṭapadhāna: [Kammavaṭṭa+padhāna] (ti) CL=7 Having Kammavaṭṭa (round of kamma (or) phase of kamma)) as predominance.
kammavaṭṭasaṅgahita: [Kammavaṭṭa+saṅgahita] (ti) CL=7 Counted and taken together with Kammavaṭṭa (round of Kamma).
kammavaṭṭekadesa: [Kammavaṭṭa+ekadesa] (pu) CL=7 A part of Kammavaṭṭa (round of Kamma).
kammavedanā: [Kamma+vedanā] (thī,na) CL=7 The sensation that arises together with Kamma.
kammavega: [Kamma+vega] (pu) CL=7 The impetus of Kamma. See - Vega.
kammavegakkhitta: [Kammavega+khitta] (ti) CL=7 One who was thrown by the force of Kamma.
kammavegukkhitta: [Kammavega+ukkhitta] (ti) CL=7 One who was thrown by the force of Kamma.
kammavibhajana: [Kamma+vibhajana] (na) CL=7 (1) Classifies (or) distinguishes (or) criticizes Kamma. (Ti) (2) It is a cause of the classification of Kamma. See - Mahākammavibhaṅgañāṇa.
kammavibhajanañāṇa: [Kammavibhajana+ñāṇa] (na) CL=7 The wisdom that classifies (or) criticizes (or) distinguishes Kamma. See - Mahākammavibhaṅgañāṇa.
kammavibhatti: [Kamma+vibhatti] (thī) CL=7 Classification of Kamma (or) criticized Kamma.
kammavibhaṅga: [Kamma+vibhaṅga] (pu) CL=7 (1) A section of classification of Kamma. (2) Classification of Kamma.
kammavibhāga: [Kamma+vibhāga] (pu) CL=7  Classification of Kamma. See - Kammavibhatti.
kammavikkhepa: [Kamma+vikkhepa] (pu) CL=7 Moving to and fro on the action.
kammavimukha: [Kamma+vimukha] (ti) CL=7 One who is turning away from Kamma.
kammavipattibhaya: [Kammavipatti+bhaya] (na) CL=7 Fear from the destruction of Kamma.
kammavipattidassana: [Kammavipatti+dassana] (na) CL=7 Showing a state of destruction of Kamma.
kammavipattilakkhaṇa: [Kammavipatti+lakkhaṇa] (na) CL=7 The recognized sign of the destruction of Kamma. (This sign has five factors that are Vatthu(object), ñata (well-known), kammavācā (official legal statement), sima (boundary or border), and parisā (gathering or group)).
kammavipattisampatti: [Kamma+vipatti+sampatti] (thī) CL=7 Completion of the destruction of Kamma.
kammavipāka: [Kamma+vipāka] (pu,na) CL=7 (1) The result of Kamma. (2) The intention of Magga that is a cause of the destruction of Kamma.
kammavipākaja: [Kammavipaka+jana+kvi] (ti) CL=7 It arises due to Kamma. It arises together with the fruit (or) result of Kamma. It arose as the fruit of Kamma.
kammavipākajiddhi: [Kammavipākaja+iddhi] (thī) CL=7 The psychic power that arises due to the result of Kamma. The psychic power that is arisen as the result of Kamma.
kammavipākajiddhimaya: [Kammavipākajiddhi+maya] (ti) CL=7 It is fulfilled (or) completed with power that is generated by the result of one"s deeds.
kammavipākajiddhivikārakaraṇa: [Kammavipākajiddhi+vikāra+karaṇa] (na) CL=7 Causes change for the worse with the power that is caused by the effect of actions.
kammavipākajānana: [Kammavipāka+jānana] (na) CL=7 Understanding the fruit of Kamma.
kammavipākakovida: [Kammavipāka+kovida] (ti) CL=7 One who is skillful in the fruit (or) result of Kamma.
kammavipākakusala: [Kammavipāka+kusala] (ti) CL=7 One who is skillful in the fruit (or) result of Kamma. See - Kammavipākakovida.
kammavipākantara: [Kammavipāka+antara] (na) CL=7 An occasion for the fruit of actions.
kammavipākaparicchedakañāṇa: [Kammavipāka+paricchedaka+ñāṇa] (na) CL=7 The wisdom that understands the classification of Kamma and the result (or) fruit of Kamma.
kammavipākasabhāvadassana: [Kammavipāka+sabhāva+dassana] (na) CL=7 Showing the nature of the result (or) fruit of Kamma.
kammavipākasambhava: [Kammavipāka] (ti) CL=7 [Sambhava] It arises as the result of Kamma. It arises together with the fruit of Kamma.
kammavipākavibhāgajānanañāṇa: [Kammavipāka+vibhāga+jānana+ñāṇa] (na) CL=7 The wisdom that is a cause of understanding the result of Kamma.
kammavipākavisesa: [Kammavipāka+visesa] (pu) CL=7 The superior state of the result of Kamma. See - Kammavipākantara.
kammavipākañāṇa: [Kammavipāka+ñāṇa] (na) CL=7 The wisdom that understands Kamma and the result of Kamma ( It is the 2nd wisdom in Dasabalañāṇa).
kammavipākañāṇabala: [Kammavipākañāṇa+bala] (na) CL=7 The power of wisdom that understands Kamma and the fruit of Kamma.
kammavipākañāṇabalayutta: [Kammavipākañāṇabala+yutta] (ti) CL=7 One who is connected to the power of Kammavipākañāṇa ( understanding of the fruit of actions (or) knowledge of the results of deeds).
kammavipākiddhimaya: [Kammavipāka+iddhimaya] (ti) CL=7 It is completed with the power that is the fruit of Kamma. See - Iddhimaya.
kammavipākānubandha: [Kammavipāka+anubandha] (ti) CL=7 Keeping close to the fruit (or) result of Kamma. See - Dhammatā.
kammavipākānubhavana: [Kammavipāka+anubhavana] (na) CL=7 Undergoing the result of Kamma.
kammavipākānubhavanayogga: [Kammavipākānubhavana+yogga] (ti) CL=7 Suitable for experiencing undergoing fruit of actions.
kammaviruddhasabhāva: [Kamma+viruddha+sabhāva] (ti) CL=7 Has the nature of opposition to Kamma.
kammavisesa: [Kamma+visesa] (pu) CL=7 The superior state of Kamma.
kammavisesaparibhāvitasantāna: [Kammavisesa] (pu) CL=7 [Paribhāvita+santāna] The continuity of a special state of Kamma. See - Sukkasoṇitapaccaya.
kammavisesasahita: [Kammavisesa+sahita] (ti) CL=7 Arises together with a superior state of Kamma. See - Kammavisesayoga.
kammavisesayoga: [Kammavisesa+yoga] (pu) CL=7 Yoking with a special state of Kamma.
kammavisesānapekkha: [Kammavisesa+anapekkha] (ti) CL=7 Disinterested in a superior state of Kammakāraka (doing the action).
kammavisuddhi: [Kamma+visuddhi] (thī) CL=7 The purity of Kamma. (the fulfillment of wholesome deeds).
kammavivaṭṭa: [Kamma+vivaṭṭa] (pu,na) CL=7 Turning around of kamma (or) revolution of deeds (or) cycle of action.
kammaviññāṇa:
[Kamma+viññāṇa]  CL=10 Consciousness associated with kamma, kamma-consciousness. Kamma-consciousness refers to 29 types of mundane consciousness associated with mundane volition (lokiya cetana):
1. 8 types of sense-sphere wholesome consciousness (kama-kusala)
2. 5 types of fine-material sphere wholesome consciousness (rupa-kusala)
3. 4 types of immaterial sphere wholesome consciousness (arupa-kusala)
4. 12 types of unwholesome consciousness (akusala)
Total: 29 types of mundane consciousness
kammaviññāṇakata: [Kammaviññāṇa+kata] (ti) CL=7 Should be done consciousness of action.
kammaviññāṇapaccaya: [Kammaviññāṇa+paccaya] (pu) CL=7 A cause that is consciousness of action.
kammaviññāṇānapekkha: [Kammaviññāṇa+anapekkha] (ti) CL=7 Disinterested the consciousness of action.
kammaviññāṇāyūhana: [Kammaviññāṇa+āyūhana] (na) CL=7 Striving the consciousness of action.
kammavohāra: [Kamma+vohāra] (pu) CL=7 The verbal expression that is Kamma.
kammavācakakiriyāniddesa: [Kamma+vācaka+kiriyā+niddesa] (pu) CL=7 Detailed analized deed that explains Kamma.
kammavācakkhaṇa: [Kammavācā+khaṇa] (pu) CL=7 A moment of reciting (Vinaya) proclamation of the legal proposition (or) official legal statement.
kammavācopasampadā: [Kammavācā+upasampadā] (thī) CL=7 (Vinaya) higher ordination as monastic due to reciting the Proclamation of the legal proposition (or) official legal statement.
kammavācā: [Kamma+vācā] (thī) CL=7 A word (sound) that is a cause of recitation of Kamma (or) Proclamation of the legal proposition (or) official legal statement.
kammavācābbhantara: [Kammavācā+abbhantara] (na) CL=7 Inside the proclamation of the legal proposition (or) official legal statement.
kammavācācariya: [Kammavācā+ācariya] (pu) CL=7 A religious teacher who recites Kammavācā (Proclamation of the legal proposition (or) official legal statement).
kammavācādosa: [Kammavācā+dosa] (pu) CL=7 The flaw (or) fault of Kammavācā. (There are five kinds of flaws (or) faults. Not consider for object. Not consider for Sangha, not recite as well words, as well alphabet, read Kammavācā without Ñata).
kammavācādvayābhāva: [Kammavācā+dvaya+abhāva] (pu) CL=7 Lack of two kinds of Kammavācā (Proclamation of the legal proposition (or) official legal statement).
kammavācālakkhaṇa: [Kammavācā+lakkhaṇa] (ti) CL=7 The auspicious sign that is  Kammavācā (Proclamation of the legal proposition (or) official legal statement).
kammavācānantara: [Kammavācā+anantara] (na) CL=7 Immediately following of Kammavācā (Proclamation of the legal proposition (or) official legal statement).
kammavācāniṭṭhāpana: [Kammavācā+niṭṭhāpana] (na) CL=7 Causes to complete (or) finish Kammavācā (Proclamation of the legal proposition (or) official legal statement).
kammavācānānattasabhāva: [Kammavācā+nānatta+sabhāva] (ti) CL=7 The nature of diversity of Kammavācā (Proclamation of the legal proposition (or) official legal statement).
kammavācānānattasambhava: [Kammavācānānatta+sambhava] (pu) CL=7 Takes place the diversity of Kammavācā (Proclamation of the legal proposition (or) official legal statement).
kammavācāpariyosāna: [Kammavācā+pariyosāna] (na) CL=7 The end words (sound) of Kammavācā (Proclamation of the legal proposition (or) official legal statement).
kammavācāpāḷi: [Kammavācā+pāḷi] (thī) CL=7 The alternate reading of Kammavācā (Proclamation of the legal proposition (or) official legal statement).
kammavācārahattābhāva: [Kammavācā+arahatta+abhāva] (pu) CL=7 Lack of awakened state of Kammavācā (Proclamation of the legal proposition (or) official legal statement).
kammavācāsampatti: [Kammavācā+sampatti] (thī) CL=7 The completeness of Kammavācā (Proclamation of the legal proposition (or) official legal statement). (That means Kammavācā is without fault (or) flaw).
kammavācāsampattiyutta: [Kammavācāsampatti+yutta] (ti) CL=7 Yoking (or) connecting to the completeness of Kammavācā (Proclamation of the legal proposition (or) official legal statement). (That means Kammavācā is without fault (or) flaw).
kammavāda: [Kamma+vāda] (pu) CL=7 (1) The religious belief that is Kamma. (Ti) (2) One who believes in Kamma.
kammavādī: [Kamma+vādī] (ti) CL=7 (1) The religious belief that is Kamma. (Ti) (2) One who believes in Kamma.
kammavāyusamerita: [Kamma+vāyu+samerita] (ti) CL=7 One who is thrown by the wind that is Kamma.
kammayanta: [Kamma+yanta] (na) CL=7 (A) The mechanism that is so-called the force (or) compulsion of action. (B) Mechanism (body or five aggregates embodying a being) that is related to Kamma (action). (B) See - Kammayantavighāṭana.
kammayantavighāṭana: [Kammayanta+vighāṭana] (ti) CL=7 Destroying the force or compulsion of action.
kammayantayantita: [Kammayanta+yantita] (ti) CL=7 Should drive the machine that is so-called force or compulsion of action.
kammayoni: [Kamma+yoni] (ti) CL=7 One who is born from actions.
kammayutta: [Kamma+yutta] (ti) CL=7 Connected with Kamma (action). Fit for action. See - Kammapatta.
kammañatti: [Kamma+ñatti] (thī) CL=7 Ñatti ((Vinaya) motion (or) initial statement) that is Kamma (action). -esā ñatti that is no need to chant Kammavācā ((Vinaya) proclamation of the legal proposition (or) official legal statement).
kammañña: [Kamma+ṇya] (ti) CL=7 [Kammani sādhu kammaññaṃ. Nīti, sutta. 783. Kamma+ñña. Kamme sādhu kammaniyaṃ, kammaññaṃ. Moga, 4. 73.] Fit for work. Workable.
kammaññarūpapadaṭṭhāna: [Kammañña+rūpa+padaṭṭhāna] (ti) CL=7 The proximate case that is a workable body.
kammaññatta: [Kammañña+tta] (na) CL=7 Ready (or) workable (or) suitable for use. See - Kammaññatā.
kammaññatā: [Kammañña+tā] (thī) CL=7 Ready (or) workable (or) suitable for use. workability (or) adaptability (or) readiness.
kammañātaka: [Kamma+ñātaka] (thī) CL=7 One who is having actions as a kin. See - Kammabandhu.
kammaṅga: [Kamma+aṅga] (na) CL=7 The component of Kamma. A cause that is doing an action.
kammaṭṭhāna: [Kamma+ṭhāna] (na) CL=7 [Kammassa yogasaṅkhātassa ṭhānaṃ ārammaṇabhāvena pavattiṭṭhānanti kammaṭṭhānaṃ. Tiṭṭhati ettha phalaṃ tadāyattavuttitāyāti ṭhānaṃ, kāraṇaṃ. Kammassa vipassanāya ṭhānaṃ kāraṇaṃ kammaṭṭhānaṃ. Vi, nicchaya, ṭī, 2. 377.] (1) (Meditation) See original. (2) (A) A cause that is striving meditation. The meditation that is a cause of attaining superior dhamma and special wealth (peace and tranquility). The work of Samatha, vipassanā. (B) A cause of meditating work (Bhāvanā). A close cause of the next (future) Bhāvanā that is the past Bhāvanā. (3) Making effort meditation. (4) Kammaṭṭhāna Book (pariyatta). (5) The nature (or) characteristic of Kammaṭṭhāna (meditation). (6) Concentrates and contemplates Kammaṭṭhāna. (7) The work. The matter (or) case.
kammaṭṭhānabhāvanāyogyatā: [Kammaṭṭhānabhāvanāyogya+tā] (thī) CL=7 As appropriate to develop  Kammaṭṭhāna. Fit for work.
kammaṭṭhānacitta: [Kammaṭṭhāna+citta] (na) CL=7 The meditation mind (or) intention of meditation. The mind that inclines to meditation subject (Kammaṭṭhāna).
kammaṭṭhānadāyaka: [Kammaṭṭhāna+dāyaka] (ti) CL=7 One who is offering Kammaṭṭhāna (meditating subject) A teacher who teaches the meditating subject).
kammaṭṭhānagatacitta: [Kammaṭṭhāna+gata+citta] (na) CL=7 The mind that is related to Kammaṭṭhāna (meditating subject). The mind that has inclined on Kammaṭṭhāna.
kammaṭṭhānagocara: [Kammaṭṭhāna+gocara] (pu) CL=7 (1) Object of the sense of kammaṭṭhāna (meditating subject). (Ti) (2) One who has an object of the sense of meditation.
kammaṭṭhānakammika: [Kammaṭṭhānakamma+ika] (ti) CL=7 Related to meditation. One who is practicing meditation subject.
kammaṭṭhānakathā: [Kammaṭṭhāna+kathā] (thī) CL=7 Meditation words (sound). Words (sound) related to the meditation subject.
kammaṭṭhānakāraka: [Kammaṭṭhāna+kāraka] (ti) CL=7 One who is doing (practicing) meditation subject.
kammaṭṭhānamala: [Kammaṭṭhāna+mala] (na) CL=7 The filth (or) dirt of Kammaṭṭhāna (meditation subject).
kammaṭṭhānamanasikāra: [Kammaṭṭhāna+manasikāra] (pu) CL=7 The intention of meditation subject.
kammaṭṭhānamanasikārasabhāva: [Kammaṭṭhānamanasikāra+sabhāva] (pu) CL=7 The nature of observation of Kammaṭṭhāna (meditation subject).
kammaṭṭhānamukha: [Kammaṭṭhāna+mukha] (na) CL=7 Making foremost Kammaṭṭhāna (meditation subject). See - Kammaṭṭhānasīsa.
kammaṭṭhānanimitta: [Kammaṭṭhāna+nimitta] (na) CL=7 The sign of Kammaṭṭhāna (meditation subject). An object of the sense of Kammaṭṭhāna (meditation subject).
kammaṭṭhānantarāya: [Kammaṭṭhāna+antarāya] (pu) CL=7 The Dangers for Kammaṭṭhāna (meditation subject).
kammaṭṭhānaparamparā: [Kammaṭṭhāna+paramparā] (thī) CL=7 The succession of Kammaṭṭhāna (meditation subject).
kammaṭṭhānapariggāhaka: [Kammaṭṭhāna+pariggāhaka] (ti) CL=7 One who is acquired Kammaṭṭhāna (meditation subject).
kammaṭṭhānapariharaṇa: [Kammaṭṭhāna+pariharaṇa] (na) CL=7 The intention of Kammaṭṭhāna (meditation subject). See - Nipaka.
kammaṭṭhānapariharaṇapaññā: [Kammaṭṭhānapariharaṇa+paññā] (thī) CL=7 The wisdom that is the comprehension of Kammaṭṭhāna (meditation subject). See - Nipaka.
kammaṭṭhānapariharaṇañāṇa: [Kammaṭṭhānapariharaṇa+ñāṇa] (na) CL=7 The wisdom that is nurturing Kammaṭṭhāna (meditation subject).
kammaṭṭhānapariharaṇūpāya: [Kammaṭṭhāpariharaṇa+upāya] (pu) CL=7 A cause of nurturing meditating subject.
kammaṭṭhānaparipālaka: [Kammaṭṭhāna+paripālaka] (ti) CL=7 One who practices (or) watches meditation subject.
kammaṭṭhānapariyuṭṭhita: [Kammaṭṭhāna+pariyuṭṭhita] (ti) CL=7 One who practices mediation subject.
kammaṭṭhānaparāyaṇa: [Kammaṭṭhāna+parāyaṇa] (ti) CL=7 One who is depending on meditation.
kammaṭṭhānapathavī: [Kammaṭṭhāna+pathavī] (thī) CL=7 The land that is a meditation subject.
kammaṭṭhānappanā: [Kammaṭṭhāna+appanā] (thī) CL=7 Concluding of meditation (or) absorption of meditation.
kammaṭṭhānappaṭibaddha: [Kammaṭṭhāna+paṭibaddha] (ti) CL=7 Connected to the meditation subject.
kammaṭṭhānapāḷiāruḷha: [Kammaṭṭhānapāḷi+āruḷha] (ti) CL=7 Wearing (or) putting on meditation subject.
kammaṭṭhānasabhāvupadhāraṇa: [Kammaṭṭhāsabhāva+upadhāraṇa] (na) CL=7 Consideration of the nature of meditation.
kammaṭṭhānasallakkhaṇavasappavatta: [Kammaṭṭhāna+sallakkhaṇa+vasa+pavatta] (ti) CL=7 Occurring by the power of concentration and contemplation on Kammaṭṭhāna. See - Sati.
kammaṭṭhānasampattijānana: [Kammaṭṭhāna+sampatti+jānana] (na) CL=7 Knowing the attainment of Kammaṭṭhāna (meditation subject). See - Sampajāna.
kammaṭṭhānasappāya: [Kammaṭṭhāna+sappāya] (ti) CL=7 (1) Supportive for meditation subject. (2) One who practices kammaṭṭhāna (meditation).
kammaṭṭhānasaññita: [Kammaṭṭhāna+saññita] (ti) CL=7 Recognized by Kammaṭṭhāna (or) so-called Kammaṭṭhāna (meditation subject).
kammaṭṭhānasuddhika: [Kammaṭṭhāna+suddhi+ka] (ti) CL=7 One who is purified by meditation.
kammaṭṭhānathambha: [Kammaṭṭhāna+thambha] (pu) CL=7 The pillar that is Kammaṭṭhāna (meditation subject).
kammaṭṭhānatthika: [Kammaṭṭhāna+atthika] (ti) CL=7 One who is wanting Kammaṭṭhāna (meditation subject).
kammaṭṭhānavihāra: [Kammaṭṭhāna+vihāra] (pu) CL=7 Mode of living with Kammaṭṭhāna (meditation). One who is practicing meditation.
kammaṭṭhānavikkhepa: [Kammaṭṭhāna+vikkhepa] (pu) CL=7 Moving to and fro of Kammaṭṭhāna (meditation).
kammaṭṭhānavimutti: [Kammaṭṭhāna+vimutti] (thī) CL=7 Liberated (from Nīvaraṇa) by practicing meditation.

He is poor and sells grass. One day he is going to cut grass.  At that time he sees an Arahant and listens to the Dhamma from this Thera and then he puts on a rag robe at a place and ordains as a Bhikkhu. When he isn"t happy in monkhood, he sees a torn cloth and takes it with apprehension to disrobe. But when he is not filled with apprehension, he disrobed. (He did this 7 times)  One day while celebrating the preaching of the dhamma ceremony, he is sitting at the border of the audience and is drowsy, Lord Buddha preaches the dhamma based on this Kappaṭakura Thera, and after meditating and soon he attains Arahattaphala).

kappaṭṭhiyapāṭihāriya:
[Kappaṭṭhiya+pāṭihāriya]  CL=9 Question: ကမ္ဘာပတ်လုံးတည်သော ပြာဋိဟာ။(၁)လ၌ ယုန်ရေးအမှတ်တံဆိပ်။(၂)ငုံးဇာတ်၌လာသော မီးငြိမ်းရာဌာနကို မီးမလောင်နိုင်ခြင်း။(၃)ဃဋိကာရအိုးထိန်းသည်၏ အိမ်မြေနေရာကို မိုးမစွတ်ခြင်း။(၎)ဧကနိပါတ်၊ သီလဝဂ်၊ ၁ဝ-ခုမြောက် နဠပါနဇာတ်လာ ရေကန်အနီး၌ ပေါက်သော ကြူပင်တို့သည် ဘုရားလောင်းမျောက်မင်း၏ အဓိဋ္ဌာန်ကြောင့် တစ်စပ်တည်းသော အခေါင်းရှိခြင်း(အဆစ်မရှိခြင်း)၊ ထိုပြာဋိဟာ ၎-မျိုးတို့သည် ဤကမ္ဘာပတ်လုံး မပျက်မစီးတည်ရှိလိမ့်မည်။
NORBU: Translation:
World-lasting miracles. (1) Rabbit mark on the moon. (2) Fire-proof area in the Quail Jataka. (3) Rain not wetting the house site of potter Ghatikara. (4) In Ekanipata, Silavagga, 10th Nalapana Jataka, reeds near the pond becoming jointless (having continuous hollow) due to the resolution of the Bodhisatta monkey king. These miracles will endure undestroyed throughout this world-cycle.

[Kappiya+bhūmi]  CL=10 (1) Gifted land. (2) Gifted monastery. (3) Gifted place.
Areas suitable for Udakukkhepasima (water-splash boundary), places where a single bhikkhuni can enter another village, bhikkhuni monasteries suitable for consultation, dining halls within monasteries, non-Buddhist monasteries, and places where bhikkhunis have stayed where monks can move about.

kappiyākappiyapathavī: [Kappiyākappiya+pathavī]  CL=7 Earth that is permitted or not permitted for use. (1) Suddhapathavī, which refers to pure and clean soil or clay. (2) Missakapathavī that is mixed with two-thirds soil powder and one-third pebbles. (3) A pile of soil or clay that is wet by rainwater over four months. (4) These three types of soil, which have not been burned by fire, are called Jātapathavī. Soil that has been burned by fire or soil mixed with more than one-third of pebbles is called Ajātapathavī. This type of earth, which is permissible for bhikkhus to dig, excavate, or destroy, is called Kappiyapathavī.

kasiṇāyatana:
[Kasiṇa+āyabhana]  CL=10 (1) The object (ārammaṇa) that is the basis or foundation for kasina (jhāna). (This is called kasiṇāyatana because it is the basis or foundation for jhāna along with its associated mental factors. When considering the term āyatana in relation to the kasina object, one should not take the ordinary kasina disk, but rather the counterpart sign (paṭibhāga-nimitta) as the object.)
(2) The jhāna that is the cause, known as kasina; kasina jhāna. (According to the first meaning, it is definitively called kasiṇāyatana because it is the cause of happiness for the yogi. According to the latter meaning, the term kasiṇāyatana, which refers to the kasina object as a place, is metaphorically applied to the jhāna that occurs in that place.)
